title: Predicting pressure gradient using artificial intelligence for transcatheter aortic valve replacement.
summary: Primary article evaluates an AI model to predict post-TAVR pressure gradient using clinical/echocardiographic variables and reports cohort performance against measured gradients. Bounded retrospective clinical prediction; no outcome benefit claim.
